decisions.reason: Although this semi-hard cheese wheel fits the firm's core cheese knowledge well, its disappearance from the website after 2019 suggests weak commercial traction and limited learning value relative to keeping a narrow, efficient portfolio.

The spicy cheese line builds on existing capabilities, but the later lack of visibility despite several variants points to assortment complexity without enough payoff, so resources are better shifted to stronger core products or new development.

This mild creamy soft cheese is closely related to the firm's expertise, yet its low strategic prominence and subsequent non-observation indicate that the firm likely cannot turn market feedback into a sufficiently attractive position within its focused organic range.

Washed-rind soft cheese is related to the firm's cheese base but requires more demanding process control and consumer acceptance, and its later absence is a strong signal that the product should be withdrawn in favor of more reliable core lines.
